integrity: All proof claims are stated for explicitly defined graph families, ranks and generating alphabets; numerical checks are reproducible by verify.py.
scientific_limitations: Counts labeled, rank-optimal generator words for paths and simple cycles only. No general graph theorem or distinct-element enumeration. The finite checks corroborate but do not replace the proof; originality remains qualified and no independent audit was performed.
